calculation_handling.description: The setback regulations 10.5.40.70(1) and 10.10.40.70(1)-(4) do not apply to a transportation use along Eglinton Avenue West and East, provided setbacks are between 0 and 10.5 m.
calculation_handling.gaps: Transportation use (Eglinton transit) has no vocab.uses token and is outside MaxBLD building types. The 0 to 10.5 m setback range is a proviso on the exemption with no DSL target for transit setbacks; recorded as threshold_used_in_application. Area is described by street, so applies_to is map_area. No zone named in the text.

units.disclosure: Transit facilities along Eglinton Avenue are exempt from the normal R-zone setbacks (setbacks between 0 and 10.5 m); this does not affect houses and is not evaluated.

10.10.40.71(1).explanation: Transit (transportation use) facilities along Eglinton Avenue East and West are exempt from the usual R-zone setback rules, as long as their setbacks are between 0 and 10.5 m. This does not affect residential buildings.
